A1Action.description:
The actions this file implements, by their `physics.toml` names (snake case). Part of
`kid::KidAction`.

oneOf.description: Step action 6 (rely): gravity 0 while `onPlatform`, overriding the Step's gravity reset.
Step action 7 (rely): while `image_alpha < 1`, add `misc.fade_step`; no clamp.

A2Action.description:
The actions this file implements, by their `physics.toml` names (snake case). Part of
`kid::KidAction`.

oneOf.description:
Animus and easy-miku-2, the end of the movement action: with a `block` or `solidblock` 1 px
below, a press of A (`extra1`) subtracts 1 from `hspeed` and a press of D (`extra2`) adds 1.

A3Action.description:
The actions this file implements, by their `physics.toml` names (snake case). Part of
`kid::KidAction`.

oneOf.description:
Step action 4 step 1 (wanna, showdown, rori, fairy-tale): the game's own key flags. Left,
Right and Jump flags become 1 on the key's press tick and 0 on its release tick; they are
not the key's state. With a press and a release in one tick the flag ends 0 (OPEN). The
flags live in `KidGlobalsExt`, so they outlive the kid.

Step action 5 (wanna): the Suicide key held (not a press) outside a Boot, Title, Menu or
Select room runs `killPlayer` every tick.

A4Action.description:
The actions this file implements, by their `physics.toml` names (snake case). Part of

A5Action.description:
The actions this file implements, by their `physics.toml` names (snake case). Part of
`kid::KidAction`.

oneOf.description:
little-runner's End Step: gravity is `numbers.gravity` every tick (frozen or not); then,
when the kid overlaps a solid at its position, `y` goes back to `yprevious` and the kid
moves to contact toward where it was (`move_contact_solid` with no limit). `vspeed` is
kept. (The original's `obj_wall` slope branches never run: no such object is placed.)

AirJump.description: What `[jump] air` names as the air-jump model.

oneOf.description: The `djump` flag (A1-A5).

BAction.description:
The actions this file implements, by their `physics.toml` names (snake case). Part of
`kid::KidAction`.

oneOf.description: End Step, `playerSlope`: the `slope_wall` slope code and the gravity restore.

`playerMisc` 1 (Step): the kid dies when it touches a `killer` instance. The Step runs
before motion, so this is the position the last tick ended at.

Step, `playerMove` steps 1-2: `image_yscale` takes the current `yflag`, then `yflag`
follows `global.reverse` (the kid's mask flips one tick after the global does).

`playerReverse` (the gravity arrows' Alarm 1): `global.reverse` toggles, `yflag` negates,
`y` moves 4 times the new `yflag`, `curJumps` 1 and `vspeed` 0.
Room Start: with `global.reverse` view 0 is enabled at angle 180, else its angle is 0.
Room Start and `playerMisc`: a bow at the kid unless one exists.

Alarm 0 with jump cancelling off (`jump.cancel = "poll_alarm"`): while Jump is up and the
kid moves against gravity, `vspeed` times `release_mult` and the alarm stops; else the
alarm is armed again for 1 tick.

BRun.description:
The collision runs this file implements, by their `physics.toml` names (snake case). Part

BlockRun.description:
The collision runs this file implements, by their `physics.toml` names (snake case). Part

oneOf.description: Kid A1 block contact, steps 1-3 above.
No slope rule in the block contact.

Rainbow: after the contact, the matching slope `step` px ahead and a free spot `step` up
move the kid there.

Rori, fairy-tale: instead of the contact, the shifted kid overlapping the matching slope
moves it `step` sideways and up, with no free-spot test.

BoundaryModel.description: `events.boundary`: how the kid handles the room edge (plan 5.3 edge row).

oneOf.description: Nothing: the kid is not told about the edge.

Intersect Boundary tests the origin: outside the room (strictly) kills the kid unless an
`edge_warp` overlaps it, which warps it; then the kid wraps to the opposite edge (A1).

Like `intersect_origin` with machinary's fixed numbers (A4): the edges are 800 by 608
whatever the room, the wrap adds or subtracts 800 sideways, adds 608 at the top and
subtracts 600 (not 608) at the bottom.
Outside Room kills the kid unless a room changer overlaps (family B, WP5b).
The origin test runs in End Step (WP5c).

CAction.description:
The actions this file implements, by their `physics.toml` names (snake case). Part of
`kid::KidAction`.

oneOf.description:
Step 3-4: `onVineL` / `onVineR`: the distance to the nearest left or right vine is at most
1 and the kid is free 1 px in the gravity direction. Computed before the jump code; the
`vines` action (step 12) reads them.
Step 10: the Suicide key pressed (not held) runs `killPlayer`, when not frozen.

Key C pressed (kid/C.md "Key C pressed"): the kid moves to the top-left of the
`kid_start` marker (17 px left of and 23 px above the normal spawn). Speeds, `djump` and
the room are unchanged; frozen does not gate it. Nothing without a marker in the room.
Listed under `events.keys` for the client action `extra1`.

ClassName.description: A collision class by its package name.

CommonAction.description:
The actions this file implements, by their `physics.toml` names (snake case). Part of
`kid::KidAction`.

oneOf.description: Create step 1-2: the numbers, flags and facing a new kid starts with.
Create step 3: the world controller if the game has none in the room.
Create step 6: a bow at the kid's position.
Create step 4: when no save exists, deaths and time 0 and a save at the kid's position.
Create step 5: alarm 0 = `room_speed`.
Step action 2 step 4: gravity back to its constant unless on a ladder.
Step action 3 steps 1-4: direction keys, facing, horizontal speed, running and idle sprites.
Step action 3 step 5: jump and fall sprites, and `onPlatform` release.
Step action 3 step 6: the speed clamp, by `fall_cap.rule`.
Step action 3 step 7: shoot on press.
Step action 3 step 7: `playerJump` on press.
Step action 3 step 7: `playerVJump` on release.
Step action 4: vines.

Step (spook house): with `frozen` the whole rest of the Step list is skipped (the code
writes no `hspeed`, gravity or `vspeed`). `kid::on_event` runs this one itself.

Step (B): with `frozen2`, gravity, `image_speed` and speed become 0 and the rest of the
Step list is skipped. `kid::on_event` runs this one itself.
Alarm 0: outside the menu roles `global.time` + 1, then alarm 0 = `room_speed` again.
Key Q pressed (and the killPlayer calls of key rows): the death sequence.

DeathRun.description:
The collision and key runs of this file, by their `physics.toml` names. Part of
`kid::KidCollisionRun`.

oneOf.description: `{ with = "killer", run = "kill" }`: the other instance kills the kid.

DeathStep.description:
One step of the death sequence (kid/A1.md "Death"). `[death] order` lists them in the order a
family runs them.

oneOf.description: The death sound, played by the death step `sound`.
Family B: creates the `death_sound` engine object (music fade, death sound a tick later).
A blood emitter at the kid's position.
Destroy the kid.
Destroy every kid instance (family B: "destroy every player instance").
`global.death` plus 1 (checked).
The death-only save (`saveDeathTime`): counters into the save slot.

The GAMEOVER display. It places itself at view 0 plus its own `offset_x`/`offset_y`
params in its Create (`game_over` built-in), so the offset is not a kid field.

Downhill.description: The End Step downhill snap models.

oneOf.description: No snap.

Poronkusema: `vspeed >= 0`, free below, on a slope last step and a slope within 12 px: down
to contact by at most 12, running or idle sprite; then remember a slope 1 px below.
Rainbow: a slope within 5 px below, then a mirrored one: down to contact by at most 10.
Fairy-tale: no block 1 px below and a slope 3 px below at `xprevious`: down by at most 10.
`abs(vspeed) > max_vspeed` gives `sign(vspeed) * max_vspeed` (A1).
Clamp against gravity only (B).
Clamp downward only (spook).
Shift, then clamp (A4).

FlipAction.description:
The actions this file implements, by their `physics.toml` names (snake case). Part of
`kid::KidAction`.

oneOf.description:
`scrFlipGrav` (family C, `flip.model = "grav_sign"`): `grav` negates, `djump` 1, `vspeed` 0,
gravity takes the new sign, `image_yscale` follows (the mask mirrors with it) and `y` moves
4 times the new `grav`. Also `kid::api::flip_grav`, for the gravity arrows.

Group A Step (`flip.model = "swap_object"`, A1 Step action 5): when `global.grav` no longer
matches this kid object, the facing goes to `global.image_xscale`, the other kid object
is created at `y - 4` (to the flipped object) or `y + 4` (back to the normal one), and this
instance is destroyed. The new kid starts from its Create: speeds 0, `djump` true.

FlipKind.description: The flip models of plan 5.3, by their `physics.toml` names.

oneOf.description: The game has no gravity flip.
Group A (11 games): swap to the flipped kid object at y - 4 (`flip_swap`, WP5c).
Family B: the yflag (WP5b).
Family C: the sign of grav (WP5c).

FlipModel.description:
`[flip]`: how gravity flips (plan 5.3 flip rows). WP5c adds the other fields
(`mask_flipped`, ...).

solidblock_no_refresh.description:
`swap_object`: the flipped kid's solidblock contact does not restore `djump` (Kotaro
player2 sets a misspelled `djump2` there, kid/A2.md).

GravityReapply.description: When gravity is set back to its constant.

oneOf.description: Every Step, unless the kid is on a ladder (A1: Step action 2.4).
Other models (WP5b, WP5c).
Only at Create.

GroundAlso.description: An extra ground-jump condition besides the classes.

oneOf.description: `onPlatform` counts as ground.
`ladderjump` counts as ground.

IceAction.description:
The actions this file implements, by their `physics.toml` names (snake case). Part of
`kid::KidAction`.

oneOf.description:
Showdown Step action 3 (kid/A3.md): with a slip block within `ice.temp_probe` px below,
`tempHspeed` stores `hspeed` when it is 0 or when the two have the same sign and `hspeed`
is not 0; otherwise (opposite sign, or `hspeed` 0) `hspeed` gains `tempHspeed`, which is
multiplied by `ice.temp_decay` and becomes 0 below `ice.temp_zero_below`. Off ice it is 0.

IceModel.description: How the kid's walk reads `slip` blocks.

oneOf.description: The game has no ice, or the walk ignores it.

While a slip block is within `probe` px, walking adds `slip * h` to `hspeed` (read at
`read` px) and standing subtracts `slip * sign(hspeed)`.

IceRules.description: `[ice]`: slip blocks and ice (kid/A1.md Step action 3, kid/A3.md showdown Step action 3).

clamp.description: Slip is clamped to the run speed (C); otherwise it is not (A1, A2, B).

probe.description: Pixels in the gravity direction probed for a `slip` block (4).

read.description: Pixels in the gravity direction at which the slip value is read (10).

temp_decay.description:
`ice_temp_hspeed`: `tempHspeed` is multiplied by this each tick off a push: the GML literal
`0.95` under the recorder model, 0.9500000000000001 (N14; `traces/showdown/a3-t19-a.csv`
tempHspeed 3.0 -> 2.85, not 2.8499999999999996).

temp_zero_below.description: `ice_temp_hspeed`: `tempHspeed` becomes 0 once its size is below this (0.2).

JumpCancel.description: How the jump cut works (`[jump] cancel`).

oneOf.description: The `release` action reads the release edge (every game with the cut switched on).

B's switch for jump cancelling off: a first jump arms Alarm 0 each tick and the
`cancel_poll` action cuts the jump when the key is up. The `release` action does nothing.

KeyOn.description: Which edge of a key a row reacts to.

oneOf.description: Keyboard (held).
Key press.
Key release.

KidAction.description:
One named action in a `physics.toml` event list (`step = ["walk", "jump", ...]`, plan 5.2).

Split by owner like `KindState`: each part is the enum of one file under `actions/`, and the
name in the file picks the part whose enum has that name (`untagged`). Names must be unique
across parts.

KidCollision.description:
One `events.collisions` row: the kid runs `run` when it collides with an instance of class
`with`.

KidCollisionRun.description:
One named collision run in `events.collisions` (`{ with = "block", run = "block_standard" }`,
plan 5.2). Split by owner like [`KidAction`].

KidFamily.description:
The kid engine family a profile starts from (`preset = "A1"`): documentation and defaults
(`kid::presets::apply`). Nothing in the sim branches on it.

oneOf.description: kid/A1.md.
kid/A2.md.
kid/A3.md.
kid/A4.md.
kid/A5.md.
kid/B.md.
kid/C.md.

action.description: The client action by its package name (`"suicide"`).

`[sounds]` as written in a package: sound names by role, resolved to [`KidSounds`] ids by the
loader.

KidSpriteNames.description:
`[sprites]` as written in a package: sprite names by role, resolved to [`KidSprites`] ids by

LadderAction.description:
The actions this file implements, by their `physics.toml` names (snake case). Part of
`kid::KidAction`.

oneOf.description:
Step action 2, instead of `gravity` (it includes the gravity reset, so the two are never
listed together): `ladderud` clears; Up or Down (`[ladder] entry`) held, off a ladder and
overlapping one: on the ladder with `djump`; on a ladder with none overlapping any more:
off; otherwise Up moves `y` up by the run speed, Down moves it down, each with gravity and
`vspeed` 0 and `ladderud` 1, and Jump held leaves with `ladderjump`. Off the ladder
gravity returns to `numbers.gravity`. The keys are direct reads.

End Step: on a ladder the `back` sprite (`image_speed` 0.1), moving on it the
`ladder_up_down` sprite (0.2).
End Step: `ladderjump` clears (rori has only this part).
Up or Down held (little-trap, rainbow).
Up held only (rori, fairy-tale).

MirrorContact.description:
The contact direction of the `slope_mirror` row's right hit (kid/A1.md, "Collision with
nanameblockR").

oneOf.description: The block rule: a right hit contacts toward 0, `hspeed` 0 toward 180.
Rori: a right hit and `hspeed` 0 contact toward 180 (a bug the original keeps).
Fairy-tale: a right hit and `hspeed` 0 contact toward 0.

MovingBlockRun.description:
The collision runs this file implements, by their `physics.toml` names (snake case). Part
of `kid::KidCollisionRun`.

oneOf.description:
Poronkusema, Collision with movingBlock, in this order:
- ride from above: `y <= other.y + vspeed + 2`, the kid moving down relative to the block
  (`vspeed > other.vspeed`) and `other.y - yprevious >= 8`: `y = other.y - 9`, `vspeed` the
  block's, `onPlatform` and `djump` set;
- bump from below: `yprevious - other.y >= height + 10`: `y = other.y + height + 12` and
  `vspeed` the block's when that is 0 or more, else 0;
- else pushed out sideways: `x = other.x - 6` or `other.x + width + 5`, whichever side of
  the block's middle the kid is on.

OPEN (the spec gives the numbers, not every test): the "within `vspeed + 2`" reading, the
relative-motion test and the choice of side (#314).

PlatformRule.description: When a platform collision lands the kid.

oneOf.description: `y - vspeed / 2 <= platform.y`: the kid was at or above the top half a step ago (A1).

PlatformRun.description:
The collision runs this file implements, by their `physics.toml` names (snake case). Part
of `kid::KidCollisionRun`.

oneOf.description: Kid A1 platform contact.

PlatformTake.description: What a landing copies from the platform.

oneOf.description: The platform's `vspeed` (A1).
The platform's `y - yprevious` (family B, WP5b).
Family C (WP5c).

Real.description:
A GM8 real: one IEEE binary64 double.

Arithmetic is plain f64 arithmetic. Equality and `Eq` compare the bit pattern, so `Real` can
key ordered maps; `0.0` and `-0.0` differ, and a NaN equals itself. For GML-style value
comparison use [`gm_eq`] and friends.

`Hash` and `Serialize` use [`Real::canonical_bits`], so every NaN hashes and serializes as
[`Real::CANONICAL_NAN_BITS`] whatever payload the platform produced. The state hash is BLAKE3
over the postcard encoding (plan 10.1); `Hash` is only for test maps. Deserializing keeps the
bits it reads.

SavePosition.description: How a save stores the position (`save.rs` `SavedPosition`), by its package name.

oneOf.description: Base-100 bytes (13 games).
Base-256 bytes (little-runner).
Text with two decimals (machinary, eat-the-new-year).
`xprevious` and `yprevious` (kaenbyou, eat-the-lemon).
A fixed point (poronkusema); needs `save.fixed`.
Floor with the `place_free` nudge (xia).

SlopeAction.description:
The actions this file implements, by their `physics.toml` names (snake case). Part of
`kid::KidAction`.

oneOf.description:
The end of `playerJump` (rainbow, rori, fairy-tale): on a Jump press, with a `slope` or
`slope_mirror` within `[slope] jump_probe` px below, a single jump is forced: `vspeed` is
`-numbers.jumps[0]` and `djump` is set. It runs after the normal jump, so it can override a
double jump of the same press.
End Step, `[slope] downhill` (see `Downhill`).

SlopeModel.description:
`[slope]`: the slopes of group A and eat-the-new-year (kid/A1.md poronkusema, rainbow, rori,
fairy-tale; kid/A4.md). `slope` rises to the right, `slope_mirror` to the left. A game's slope
kinds carry only those classes (not `block`), so the kid's `slope` and `slope_mirror`
collision rows run alone, as the original's child-object events do.

air_sprite_probe.description:
`air_sprite`: no fall sprite while a slope lies this many pixels below (rori, fairy-tale: 2).
0 means off.

block_step.description: How the horizontal block contact climbs (`block_slope_step`).

jump_probe.description:
`slope_jump`: with a slope or mirrored slope within this many pixels below a Jump press
forces a single jump (rainbow, rori, fairy-tale: 2). 0 means off.

keep_hspeed.description:
`walk` keeps `hspeed` while a slope is 1 px below and the key points downhill
(eat-the-new-year, kid/A4.md).

mirror_contact.description:
Which way the `slope_mirror` row's contact goes for a right hit or `hspeed` 0, when the
climb does not apply (rori: `left`, a bug the original keeps; fairy-tale: `right`).

step.description: The climb: 3 px sideways and 3 px up.

SlopeRun.description:
The collision runs this file implements, by their `physics.toml` names (snake case). Part
of `kid::KidCollisionRun`.

oneOf.description:
The block contact with the climb of `[slope] block_step` in its horizontal part. Used by the
`block`, `slope` and `slope_mirror` rows of rainbow, rori and fairy-tale (kid/A1.md).

Poronkusema, Collision with nanameblock: the vertical block part; a rise found by testing
0 to 9 px up with the kid shifted by `hspeed` (0 when still inside a slope at 9, or when the
found spot overlaps a block); then `x` moves `step` in the direction of `hspeed` (even with
rise 0), `y` goes up by the rise, `hspeed` 0 and the diagonal check.

Eat-the-new-year, Collision with yaneH (`slope`) or yaneM (`slope_mirror`): when
`place_free(x + hspeed, y)` is false and `hspeed >= 0` (H; `<= 0` for M, OPEN: mirrored) and
`place_free(x, y + vspeed)` is false, the kid moves `step` up and sideways; `hspeed` 0.
Then the vertical and diagonal block parts.

VineKeys.description: How the vine action reads its kick and drop keys.

oneOf.description: This tick's key press edge (A1, A2, B).
Game-side latched flags (wanna, rori, fairy-tale, showdown; WP5c).
No vines.
Left vine below `left_below`, right vine exactly `right_equal` (A, B).
Both sides within one pixel (C, WP5c).

WalkRead.description: How the walk action reads the direction keys.

oneOf.description:
`keyboard_check_direct`: held, or latched since the last direct read
(`InputState::direct`; trick.restart_glitch).
The tick's sampled held state.

WaterAir.description: When water 2 allows the air jump.

oneOf.description: Never.
A water 2 one pixel below allows the air jump even without `djump` (A1).
Family B (WP5b).
Family C (WP5c).

description:
A profile as written, before the preset fills its defaults. `toml::from_str` target of
`crates/format` (WP7b); `kid::presets::apply` turns it into a [`PhysicsProfile`]: the
preset's profile with every field written here put over it. The sections of families that
have not landed (`[ice]`, `[slope]`, `[ladder]`, `[flip]`) replace the preset's whole.

sounds.description: `[sounds]`: sound names; the loader resolves them to ids like the sprite names.

sprites.description:
`[sprites]`: sprite names. `kid::presets::apply` leaves the profile's `sprites` empty;
the loader (WP7b) resolves these names to ids and fills them in.
